Complaint form | Name: [CUSTOMER] | Account: current acct ending [ACCOUNT_1] | Contact email: [EMAIL_1] | Preferred contact: email
What happened: My wages go into my instant saver and on payday I move what I need into my current account to cover my bills. Friday 30th was payday and your app and online banking were down ALL DAY. I tried from about 8am, kept getting 'something went wrong'. Phone line was over an hour wait and I was at work. My energy direct debit (Lumen Home Energy, £96.40) bounced because the money was stuck in my savings. You then charged me £15 for the unpaid item and Lumen have added a £20 late payment fee. This was not my fault, it was your system.
What would put it right: Refund the £15 and pay me the £20 Lumen charged. That's all I want.

INCIDENT INC-2026-1030-01 (P1) Service: H&V mobile app + online banking. Impact: app and online banking unavailable 30/10/2026 07:10-15:40. Cause: failed certificate rotation on authentication gateway following overnight change CHG-88213. Card payments and ATMs unaffected, 3DS in-app approvals unavailable for duration. Telephone banking queues peaked 74 min. Status: RESOLVED 15:40. Customer impact review: open, owner Digital Ops.

CA [ACCOUNT_1]. 30/10/2026 00:01 Credit BACS SALARY ref 'ARDEN LOGISTICS PAY' to SAV [ACCOUNT_2] GBP 1,842.17. 30/10/2026 06:00 DD presented LUMEN HOME ENERGY GBP 96.40. Available balance GBP 31.08. DD RETURNED UNPAID (ARUDD reason 0 refer to payer) 30/10/2026 17:30. 02/11/2026 Unpaid item fee GBP 15.00 debited. No transfers SAV>CA 30/10. Last transfer SAV>CA 30/09/2026 08:14 GBP 1,200.00 (mobile).
